reason: The invoice bug is exactly the kind of thing I want caught, but "AI explores your app and writes the business rules" is the pitch I've heard before and it never held up on a real legacy client app. Free doesn't make it free for me: setting it up on a client's old app eats billable hours, and I'd rather write a few targeted tests on the totals I know matter.
objection: I don't believe AI-inferred business rules will catch the subtle stuff, like a rounding or tax change on an invoice total. I'll either drown in false-positive diffs or miss the one field that matters, and either way I'd end up checking everything by hand anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on a real legacy app, ideally one of ours, and flag a real regression like a changed invoice total that our tests missed, with low noise and setup in under an hour.
